description: This source file defines a singleton enum CLIInstaller with static methods to locate, verify, and install the openclaw CLI tool. It includes functions for checking if the CLI is installed, determining its location, and performing installation via a shell script. It also defines a private struct InstallEvent used for parsing installation event logs.

classes.name: InstallEvent
classes.description: Struct for decoding installation event logs from JSON output during CLI installation.

methods.name: installedLocation
methods.description: Returns the file system path where openclaw CLI is installed, searching recommended paths.

methods.name: installedLocation(searchPaths:fileManager:)
methods.description: Internal method that searches given paths to find the CLI executable.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks if openclaw CLI is installed by verifying its location.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs installation of the openclaw CLI by executing an installation script, updating status via a handler.

methods.name: installPrefix
methods.description: Returns the path prefix where the CLI will be installed.

methods.name: installScriptCommand
methods.description: Constructs the shell command to download and run the installation script with specified version and prefix.

methods.name: parseInstallEvents
methods.description: Parses stdout from installation command into a list of InstallEvent objects.

methods.name: shellEscape
methods.description: Escapes strings for safe inclusion in shell commands.
